no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Sunshine Biopharma's commercial business sells 71 generic prescription drugs in Canada via subsidiary Nora Pharma (plus OTC supplements via Sunshine Canada). Its two proprietary R&D assets per the FY2024 10-K — K1.1 mRNA-LNP for liver cancer and SBFM-PL4 small-molecule PLpro inhibitor for SARS coronaviruses — are both listed at 'Animal Testing' stage (preclinical, IND not filed). Neither is in P1/P2/P3 and neither has any registered clinical trial.

commercial_product.note: Nora Pharma markets 71 generic prescription drugs in Canada (Abiraterone, Apixaban, Atorvastatin, Azithromycin, etc.); 22 additional generics in development (12 expected in 2026). Sunshine Canada sells OTC supplements (Essential-9, Calcium-Vitamin D, L-Citrulline).
